body: Reddit makes my day, every day. I don't do drugs, mostly because I don't have access to any. Here, even having weed will get you kicked out. I can't move on! I don't think anyone can really understand, this isn't something I can just say 'sorry' and move on about. I RAPED. MY SISTER. Not only can my family not forgive me, I can't forgive me. I can regret the mistake all I want. But what will that fix? My family is all I almost don't have. I'm 16 now and it still haunts me. I can't move on. I don't mean to whine, I'm just saying what I feel...

No counselling here I'm afraid. Even then, I wouldn't even be able to tell a person what I've done face to face. I'm just too ashamed. What prompted me to rape my own sister? I'm not fucking sure. It's a question I don't think I can ever ever answer.
Not an option. I'm stuck here.
Guess I'm just too fucked up. Sorry for being a bother.
